visible_navigator.p4_rule: Do not add a second autonomous shell. Capture primary UI integrates through an adapter/candidate and preserves V53 physics/camera/back ownership.

owns: Capture entry/Inbox presentation through existing V53 human grammar

transcription.preferred_profile: Xenova/whisper-small multilingual, Spanish forced, WASM q8
transcription.fallback_policy: Explicit multilingual Base fallback when Small cannot run; never silent Tiny downgrade.

page_identity.rule: Capture context is frozen at record start. Unknown fallback IDs cannot authorize writes.

input_ownership.rule: Exactly one active gesture owner; Capture focus overlays use nested Focus Lease.

local_persistence.first_write: metadata + raw audio reference/blob before ASR result

remote_transport.role: private synchronization, Patent transport and UI status cache

context.capture_adapter_role: project private Captures into raw records/Note Atoms and selection/consumption flows

workflow.rule: Patent is transport for a Work Item, not a replacement workflow.

modification_resolution.rule: Resolve root owner before writes; page symptom does not prove page-local ownership.

receipts.rule: Transport record references standard receipt identity; it cannot override ledger/Current truth.

release.owner: single declared GitHub Pages release/publish workflow per served target
release.rule: No dual injector can write the same shell marker. Candidate → canary → Human acceptance when required → promotion → Served verification.

reason: does not require cross-origin iframe DOM access
can freeze semantic V53 page context
avoids injecting a second shell into every page
primary_ui_strategy.standalone_rule: May expose Capture on pages opened outside Navigator but consumes identical Capture core/contracts.

legacy_mapping.shared/prometeo-shell/v1/db.js: KEEP_AS_DONOR then migrate into versioned Capture local persistence
MINE Capture/Inbox/Patent behavior; do not keep as Navigator-global chrome
QUARANTINE default-on wrapper after integrated adapter replaces purpose
legacy_mapping..github/workflows/inject-prometeo-shell-: REPLACE/RETIRE after one-owner publication path exists
legacy_mapping.public.prometeo_page_memory: ADAPT as private materialized memory view, not Context authority
legacy_mapping.public.prometeo_patents: MIGRATE snapshot contract from v1 to v2
legacy_mapping.public.prometeo_receipts: ADAPT as transport mirror of standard receipts

non_regression: V53 exact visible baseline remains independently recoverable.
V23 physics oracle remains separate and unchanged.
No essential Capture action is hover-only.
Recording does not wait for transcription.
Raw audio is preserved locally on ASR failure.
Chat history is never required to understand a Patent.
LOCAL Capture cannot leak through public export by default.
Supabase outage cannot redefine product Current/Human Accepted/Served.
Source commit success is never reported as Served verification.
